scripts.dev: node scripts/check-dev-env.mjs && concurrently --kill-others --success first --names app,realtime --prefix-colors blue,magenta "node --env-file=.dev.vars scripts/run-vite.mjs dev" "node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs dev -c workers/realtime/wrangler.jsonc --port 8788 --env-file .dev.vars --persist-to .wrangler/state"
scripts.dev:realtime: node scripts/check-dev-env.mjs && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs dev -c workers/realtime/wrangler.jsonc --port 8788 --env-file .dev.vars --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.build:all: pnpm build && pnpm build:app:dry-run && pnpm build:realtime
scripts.deploy: pnpm build:all && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs deploy -c workers/realtime/wrangler.jsonc && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs deploy
scripts.preview: node scripts/check-dev-env.mjs && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs dev -c wrangler.jsonc -c workers/realtime/wrangler.jsonc --port 4173 --env-file .dev.vars --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:worker && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.gen:realtime: node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs types workers/realtime/worker-configuration.d.ts -c workers/realtime/wrangler.jsonc --env-interface RealtimeEnv --include-runtime false
scripts.gen:check: pnpm build && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs types --check && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs types workers/realtime/worker-configuration.d.ts -c workers/realtime/wrangler.jsonc --env-interface RealtimeEnv --include-runtime false --check
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm gen:check && pnpm test:unit:coverage && pnpm test:worker:coverage && pnpm build:all && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm audit --audit-level low
